description: This file defines a custom exception class NormalizeException used in the OrangeHRM project for error handling within the API serializer component.

classes.name: NormalizeException
classes.description: A custom exception class extending PHP's built-in Exception, providing static methods to create specific error instances related to model normalization in the API serializer.

methods.name: notSetRequiredAttributes
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of NormalizeException indicating that required model attributes have not been set.

methods.name: unsupportedType
methods.description: Creates and returns an instance of NormalizeException indicating that an object is of an unsupported type, specifying the required type and the actual type of the provided object.
